Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so the security team has a single thread to work from: 

Summary of ask (from your security intake):
- Confirm Redwoods's SOC 2 status and provide scope summary for inference platform (shared infra vs dedicated instances)
- Provide SSO/SAML configuration checklist and sample SCIM provisioning evidence
- Describe RBAC/admin controls and how developer/service accounts are restricted
- HIPAA/GDPR data handling notes and any contractual addenda we should expect

What I attached: 
- redwood_soc2_scope_summary.pdf — short doc with our current SOC 2 report status and what is in/out of scope
- sso_scim_evidence_template.xlsx — template table your team can use to request artifacts (screenshots, logs, configs)
- redwood_privacy_hl.pdf — one-pager on data handling highlights for regulated workloads

Proposed next steps & timeline: 
1) Your security team to confirm primary contacts and preferred delivery method (SFTP/Drive/DocuSign for forms) — target: end of week (2027-04-16)
2) We deliver the SSO/SCIM evidence template pre-populated with our configuration examples and known gaps — target: 2027-04-15
3) If you need an engineer-level call to review SAML assertion flows or SCIM attribute mappings, we can schedule a 30–45m deep dive next week

Can you confirm who on your side should receive the artifacts (security mailbox vs named contacts) and whether there are any extra regulatory checkboxes beyond SOC 2 / HIPAA that we should include?

Thanks — I’ll loop in our security lead to own the artifacts delivery once we confirm contacts.

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the templates. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we move to artifact collection: 

1) SOC 2: Is the summary you sent full scope (production inference runtime) or limited to control plane? We need to understand if inference GPU hosts are covered or just control plane services.
2) SCIM: We plan to provision across multiple teams with different roles. Will your SCIM schema support custom attributes for team_id and environment (prod/beta)?
3) RBAC: We will likely ask for evidence of separation between admin and developer consoles and a recent role-change audit log (last 90 days). Is that available?
4) Delivery: Prefer Drive link that only our security mailbox can access — we will not accept email attachments for logs.

Primary contact for artifact ingestion: security-ingest@northshorehealth.org (please grant view access to that email for Drive link).

If you can confirm the answers to 1–3 and share the pre-populated template, we’ll round up our questions and return a prioritized list.

Appreciate it —

Hi Samantha / Olga —

Thanks for flagging these items. Quick answers and an outline of how we’ll deliver artifacts: 

1) SOC 2 scope: Our current SOC 2 Type II report covers the control plane and management services in scope for hosted customers. Production inference hosts are covered when customers use Redwood Dedicated or our managed inference offering with dedicated tenancy. I attached a one-page scope excerpt (see redwood_soc2_scope_summary.pdf) — if you need the full report, we can initiate an NDA/controlled access process and share via our secure portal.

2) SCIM schema: Our SCIM implementation supports custom extensions. We can include team_id and environment as mapped attributes; I’ll pre-populate the template with examples for team_id and environment and note any attribute name collisions.

3) RBAC / audit logs: We can provide a role-change audit extract for the last 90 days for administrative accounts, plus screenshots of the admin console showing role definitions and separation. Per policy, audit logs are shared via secure Drive link with limited view permissions.

Planned deliveries (timeline):
- 2027-04-15: Pre-populated sso_scim_evidence_template.xlsx with example attribute mappings and sample screenshots
- 2027-04-16: Secure Drive link with role-change audit extract and admin console screenshots (view only for security-ingest@northshorehealth.org)
- Week of 2027-04-19: Optional engineer deep-dive (30–45m) to walk SCIM provisioning and SAML assertion flow if you want a walkthrough

Action items for NorthShore: confirm security-ingest@northshorehealth.org has view access to the Drive folder when we send it, and let us know a preferred time for the deep-dive if helpful.

- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (Ben is managing the commercial side)
